nodes.name:
echo "=================================================="
echo "🔍 FETCHING OPEN DEPENDABOT ALERTS VIA REST API"
echo "=================================================="

if ! ALERTS_JSON=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${{ github.repository }}/dependabot/alerts?state=open&per_page=100" \
  --jq '.[] | {number: .number, pkg: .dependency.package.name}'); then
  echo "❌ Unable to read Dependabot alerts. Verify token permissions (dependabot-alerts: read/write)."
  exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$ALERTS_JSON" ]; then
  echo "✅ No open Dependabot alerts found."
  exit 0
fi

# Extract direct project dependencies
DIRECT_DEPS=$(poetry run pipdeptree --json-tree | jq -r '.[].package_name' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

# Loop through each alert found
echo "$ALERTS_JSON" | jq -c '.' | while read -r alert; do
  ALERT_NUMBER=$(echo "$alert" | jq -r '.number')
  PKG_NAME=$(echo "$alert" | jq -r '.pkg')
  PKG_LOWER=$(echo "$PKG_NAME" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

  echo ""
  echo "--------------------------------------------------"
  echo "📦 Processing Alert #$ALERT_NUMBER for package: $PKG_NAME"
  echo "--------------------------------------------------"

  # 1. Check if the package is a DIRECT dependency
  if echo "$DIRECT_DEPS" | grep -q "^${PKG_LOWER}$"; then
    echo "⛔ KEEP OPEN: '$PKG_NAME' is a DIRECT dependency in pyproject.toml."
    continue
  fi
  echo "✅ '$PKG_NAME' is not a direct dependency."

  # 2. Get ALL parent packages requiring this vulnerable package
  echo "🌳 Building reverse dependency tree for '$PKG_NAME'..."
  PARENTS=$(poetry run pipdeptree -p "$PKG_NAME" --reverse --json-tree 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.. .package_name? // empty' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sort -u | grep -v "^${PKG_LOWER}$" || true)

  if [ -z "$PARENTS" ]; then
    echo "⚠️ WARNING: No parent dependencies found for '$PKG_NAME' in pipdeptree."
    echo "⛔ KEEP OPEN: Safety fallback triggered."
    continue
  fi

  echo "Found parent dependency chain(s):"
  echo "$PARENTS" | sed 's/^/   ↳ /'

  # 3. Verify if ALL parents belong exclusively to Home Assistant
  echo "🏠 Checking if all parents belong exclusively to Home Assistant..."
  IS_HA_ONLY=true

  for parent in $PARENTS; do
    IS_PARENT_IN_HA=$(poetry run pipdeptree -p homeassistant --json-tree 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.. .package_name? // empty' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | grep -x "$parent" || true)
    
    if [ -n "$IS_PARENT_IN_HA" ]; then
      echo "  [✓] Parent '$parent' IS a Home Assistant sub-dependency."
    else
      echo "  [✗] Parent '$parent' IS NOT part of Home Assistant!"
      IS_HA_ONLY=false
    fi
  done

  # 4. Auto-dismiss or keep open
  if [ "$IS_HA_ONLY" = true ]; then
    echo "🎉 DECISION: DISMISS ALERT #$ALERT_NUMBER"
    echo "   Reason: '$PKG_NAME' is exclusively used by Home Assistant."
    
    if gh api \
      --method PATCH \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
      /repos/${{ github.repository }}/dependabot/alerts/$ALERT_NUMBER \
      -f state="dismissed" \
      -f dismissed_reason="tolerable_risk" \
      -f dismissed_comment="Auto-dismissed: Package is exclusively a sub-dependency of Home Assistant."
    then
      echo "✅ Alert #$ALERT_NUMBER successfully dismissed on GitHub."
    else
      echo "⚠️ Unable to dismiss alert #$ALERT_NUMBER (permission/API limitation). Keeping it open."
    fi
  else
    echo "⛔ DECISION: KEEP ALERT OPEN"
    echo "   Reason: '$PKG_NAME' is used by other dependencies outside of Home Assistant."
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "=================================================="
echo "🏁 ANALYSIS COMPLETE"
echo "=================================================="
